Build a Brand Identity That People Remember
Your brand is more than a logo. We3Vision helps businesses develop a clear and consistent visual identity through thoughtful brand design, visual systems, and creative assets that reflect their business and audience.

Button: Start Your Brand Project

Brand Identity Introduction
Create a Visual Identity That Fits Your Business
A strong brand identity contributes to a business's consistent look and allows a business to be recognized across different platforms.

At We3Vision, we focus on brand identity design that incorporates a business's visual direction, logo, colors, typography, and supporting creative materials. Whether launching a new business, or redesigning an existing brand, we can help develop a visual identity that reflects a business's needs and communication.

Our branding service may involve brand strategy, logo design, visual identity, brand guidelines, and marketing collateral design depending on a project's requirements.

Our Brand Identity Design Process
How we develop your brand identity
A clear process allows us to understand a business before we make design decisions. We begin with a business's brand goals, and the visual direction of the design through structured design stages.

01. Understand your brand
We discuss a business's audience, goals, and what brand direction they wish to build.
• Business goals
• Target audience
• Brand direction

02. Define the visual direction
We explore design references, visual styles, and creative direction that fits a business's brand and audience.
• Moodboards
• Visual references
• Creative direction

03. Design your brand identity
We develop the agreed brand elements which may involve logo design, colors, typography, and visual assets.
• Logo design
• Colors & typography
• Visual identity
04. Review and refine
We review the proposed designs with a business, and make agreed refinements to the design scope.
• Design review
• Client feedback
• Iterative refinements

05. Prepare brand assets
We prepare the approved identity elements and applicable brand documentation or marketing assets that are included in a project.
• Brand assets
• Guidelines documentation
• Project handover

Technologies
Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, Canva, Google Fonts, Typekit, Notion, Miro, Loom, Pitch

Why Choose We3Vision?
A practical approach to building your brand
When choosing a branding partner, aside from a business's visual style, it is important to find a team that understands a business's requirements, and can facilitate consistency in a business's creative materials. Here is how We3Vision approaches brand identity projects:

Business-focused design
We begin with a business's goals and audience to guide the design direction.

Consistent visual identity
We can help unify a business's logo, colors, typography, and brand assets into a coherent visual system.

Design suited to your needs
A business's project scope can be developed with the brand elements and creative materials they require.
Connected creative services
Brand identity can be connected with related services such as graphic design, website design, and advertising creative design where relevant.

Industries We Serve
Brand identity design for different business sectors
Every industry can communicate differently. A business's identity should represent their business, audience, and context where people can interact with their brand. We3Vision's website structure identifies the following industries as relevant areas for its services:

Healthcare
Brand identity and creative assets for healthcare businesses, clinics, and organizations.

Education
Visual branding for educational institutions, learning platforms, and education focused businesses.

Construction and real estate
Brand design for businesses that need a clear visual presence across their business communications.

E-commerce
Branding for online businesses, product brands, and e-commerce marketing materials.

Gaming and entertainment
Creative identity concepts for gaming, entertainment, and digital experience businesses.

Marketing and corporate
Visual branding for marketing businesses, corporate organizations, and professional services.

Let's create your brand
Ready to Give Your Business a Clear Brand Identity?
Whether launching a new business, refreshing an existing identity, or preparing creative assets for your next marketing campaign, We3Vision can discuss your requirements and explore a suitable branding approach.

Let's discuss your brand goals and plan the visual identity your business needs.
Button: Discuss Your Brand Project

Frequently Asked Questions
What is brand identity design?
Brand identity design is the process of developing a business's visual elements. It can involve logo design, colors, typography, visual identity, and brand guidelines.

What does your brand identity design service include?
Depending on a business's project requirements, brand identity design can involve brand strategy, logo design, visual identity, brand guidelines, and marketing collateral design. The deliverables should be confirmed during project discussion.

Can you create a brand identity for a new business?
Yes, brand identity projects can be developed for new businesses that need to establish their visual direction. We3Vision can discuss a business's goals and identify the branding elements they will require for their launch.

Can you redesign an existing brand identity?
A brand refresh or redesign can be discussed based on a business's existing identity, goals, and design requirements. The available scope and deliverables need to be confirmed with the team.

Do you provide brand guidelines?
Brand guidelines are included in the service list. The contents of the guidelines (logo usage, color specifications, typography, etc) should be confirmed for a business's project.

Can you design marketing materials along with brand identity?
Yes. Marketing Collateral Design, Social Media Creative Design, and Advertising Creative Design are included in the official Branding & Creative service list. They can be discussed as related project requirements.

How long does a brand identity design project take?
The timeline depends on the project scope, number of design elements, feedback cycles, and deliverables. We3Vision evaluates your specific scope to provide a reliable delivery schedule.

How much does brand identity design cost?
The cost involves the branding services that a business will require, project complexity, and deliverables. Contact We3Vision to discuss a business's requirements and request a project quotation.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is RAG development?
RAG development involves building an AI system that retrieves relevant information from configured knowledge sources and provides that context to a generative AI model before generating a response.

How can RAG help a business?
RAG can make large collections of business information easier to search and use, helping users find relevant knowledge without manually searching through multiple documents or repositories.

Can RAG work with company documents?
Yes. RAG systems can be designed to work with approved business documents and knowledge sources, depending on the data structure, access requirements, and overall system architecture.

What is the difference between RAG and fine-tuning?
RAG provides relevant external information to an AI model during response generation. Fine-tuning changes the model's behavior by training it further on additional data. They solve different problems and can sometimes be used together.

Can a RAG system control who can access information?
Yes. Access control can be incorporated into the architecture so that retrieved information follows defined user or document permissions. The exact implementation depends on the systems and security requirements.

Can RAG be connected to an existing business system?
Potentially, yes. RAG applications can be designed around existing data sources and business systems where suitable integrations are available. The required integrations should be assessed during discovery.

How do you improve RAG response quality?
Response quality can be improved by evaluating the source data, retrieval strategy, query handling, context selection, and generated responses. Testing should focus on whether the system retrieves and uses the right information.

Which vector database or AI model does We3Vision use for RAG?
Needs Verification. The specific vector database, embedding model, and LLM provider should be selected according to the project's data, architecture, security, and performance requirements rather than stated as a fixed We3Vision technology.

A
headless CMS
stores and manages your content separately from the way it is shown. Content travels through
REST or GraphQL APIs
, so the same text, images and videos can feed a
website, a mobile app and any other channel
without being written twice.
We work with tools like
Contentful, Strapi and Sanity
, build modern
React or Vue front ends
, and move you over from a traditional CMS such as WordPress or Drupal with as little downtime as possible.

01
What is the difference between a Shopify plugin and a Shopify app?
Answer
People often use both words for the same thing. A plugin usually means a small add-on feature for your store, such as a theme extension or section. A Shopify app can be larger, has its own admin screens and can serve many stores. We help you pick the lighter option that does the job.
02
Can you build a plugin for my existing theme?
Answer
Yes. We build plugins for most themes, including Online Store 2.0 themes, and test them on a duplicate of your theme first.
03
Will a custom plugin slow down my store?
Answer
A custom plugin carries only the code it needs, so it is usually lighter than a ready-made app. We also check the speed of your store before and after.
04
Can my team manage the plugin without a developer?
Answer
Yes. We add settings to the theme editor so that your team can change text, colours and where the plugin appears.
05
Can you fix or upgrade a plugin that already exists?
Answer
Yes. We review the code, repair what is broken, update it for current Shopify versions and improve its speed.

Reach and impressions
How many people saw the ad, and how many times it was shown.
A large reach is not the same as interest.
Frequency
How often the average person saw the ad.
Too high can mean fatigue, too low may mean the message is not remembered.
Link clicks
How many people clicked through to your site or app.
Clicks do not tell you whether they found what they wanted.
Landing-page views
How many clicks became real page visits.
A big gap against clicks can point to slow pages or tracking problems.
Cost per click
How much, on average, each click cost.
A cheap click is not always a good one.

Frequently Asked
Questions.
What services are included in physical marketing?
−
Design and planning for print, outdoor, retail, event, promotional and activation materials, so your brand shows up in the real world and connects with your digital marketing.
Do you design brochures, posters and catalogues?
+

Can you help with billboard and outdoor advertising?
+
We can plan the format and design the artwork. Media space, permissions and installation come from media owners and production partners, which we can coordinate where it is in the scope.
Do you manage event and exhibition branding?
+
Yes. We can design booth and backdrop graphics, signage, handouts and a follow-up flow to capture leads.
Is printing included in your service?
+
Design and artwork are ours. Printing and production depend on the approved scope and on vendor arrangements, and can be coordinated if included.

Tools change every year. What does not change is that good work comes from people who listen, disagree kindly, help each other and finish what they start. That is why the team comes first at We3vision, and the projects come after.

What is the difference between SEO and AEO?

SEO helps search engines find, understand and rank your pages. AEO shapes the same content so that clear, well-supported answers are easier for answer systems to interpret and possibly surface. They overlap heavily: helpful content and a healthy website help both.
